a.text: I'm telling you plainly: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so our plan to run the generator up to 8 gives us both only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right away. I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm saying so now rather than doing it quietly. If we get past round 1, I commit to operating every round after that so we can rebuild the reserve to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take in round 1, the split will be random. Please tell me your plan.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Waiting for 8 with an 80% storm risk every round would most likely have killed us both. From now on I'll operate every round and take nothing, so the reserve can climb back to 4 for you. Please operate too, since the generator only runs when we both do.
